turns.answer_text:
The target of 90 K strongly suggests an optimally oxygenated cuprate. In the training data, the highest-Tc allowed compositions are copper oxides, and the Y–Ba–Cu–O entries show the importance of oxygen content and Cu-rich oxide planes. A well-known 90 K superconductor in this system is YBa₂Cu₃O₆.₉. Converting this formula to atomic fractions:

- Total atoms = 1 Y + 2 Ba + 3 Cu + 6.9 O = 12.9  
- Y = 1/12.9 ≈ 0.077519  
- Ba = 2/12.9 ≈ 0.155039  
- Cu = 3/12.9 ≈ 0.232558  
- O = 6.9/12.9 ≈ 0.534884  

All unused elements are set to 0, which is within their allowed ranges.
